about

Hi! I'm Cory, a student at the University of Mary Washington studying computer science and math. I'm currently a blockchain engineer intern at Galaxy.

I'm interested in crypto market microstructure. I built Incerto, a research terminal for crypto data, wrote empirical papers on DEX pricing, LVR, and stablecoin ownership, and publish articles with interactive demos on the statistics underneath.

incerto

A Bloomberg-style research terminal for crypto markets.

Typed market entities, an immutable raw-data store, a paper-trading engine with regime snapshots, and a keyboard-first console. Try BTC, zoom, or help once it loads.

[terminal.incerto.app]

research

  • Is Retail Dead?

    Research paper written in collaboration with Vessel.xyz examining stablecoin ownership concentration across Ethereum and Solana.

    [Paper]
  • Ethereum Congestion and the Mean Reversion of DEX-CEX Price Spreads

    Empirical research on whether Ethereum congestion slows the correction of DEX-CEX mispricing, showing that higher gas weakens price alignment when arbitrage is actively operating.

    [Paper]
  • When does LVR Outrun Fees?

    A brief empirical note on AMM liquidity provision, LVR, and toxic flow. Fee income rises in more toxic regimes, but LVR rises faster.

    [Paper]
  • The Signal and the Noise Reflection

    Some thoughts on the ways institutions incentivize inaccurate forecasting, embedded in a reflection on Nate Silver's The Signal and the Noise.

    [Paper]
